kaynak_en: Dose-pressure relation: Guo et al. (2018), Dependence of the Martian radiation environment on atmospheric depth, JGR Planets, arXiv:1712.06987 (0.222 uGy/day/Pa, ~220 uGy/day average at Gale, valid 700-950 Pa). Elevation: MGS MOLA MEGDR 16 ppd. Pressure from a hydrostatic atmosphere (scale height ~10.8 km) anchored to 840 Pa at Gale.
guven_notu_en: Seasonal pressure changes Gale dose by up to ~25%; solar activity matters more than location. Dose is estimated only inside the measured pressure range; elsewhere only atmospheric column is shown. Planning context, not a dosimetry product.
